text: At its meeting of May 18, 2023, Scarborough Community Council in adopting Item SC5.18 invited Barbara Dickson to provide a presentation at the June 27th Scarborough Community Council meeting on plans and preparations underway to honour the role that the Scarborough Bomb Girls played to support the troops in World War II.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture to work with the Agincourt Community Association (ACSA) and the Bomb Girls Banner Committee in preparing and developing the plans to honour the role the Scarborough Bomb Girls played to support the troops in World War II.
